title: Law to expand bicycle parking stations citywide
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to install at least 5,000 bicycle parking stations over five years, at a rate of at least 1,000 per year, including at least 2,000 on commercial blocks. DOT would need to consider community input, delivery worker data and proximity to bike infrastructure when choosing locations, and post a public map of all stations. By January 1, 2032, DOT must report to the Mayor and Council on the program's cost and effectiveness.
